recruitbench.canonical_name: RecruitBench: A Benchmark for AI Recruiting Systems
recruitbench.verified_provenance: Observed real-world interview advancement funnels from professional recruiting agency submissions.
recruitbench.access_restrictions: PII restrictions; candidate text is strictly access-gated and not freely downloadable as raw text in public domain.
recruitbench.corrections: RecruitBench is a real 1,594-pair interview advancement benchmark, but cannot be ingested directly into automated test pipelines without signed institutional data sharing agreements.

djinni_dataset.authors: Nazarii Drushchak and Mariana Romanyshyn (Third Ukrainian Natural Language Processing Workshop, UNLP @ LREC-COLING 2024)
djinni_dataset.citation: Proceedings of the 3rd Workshop on Ukrainian Natural Language Processing (UNLP 2024), pages 45-52
djinni_dataset.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) / MIT
djinni_dataset.dataset_scale: 210,250 English candidate profiles, 141,897 English job postings (352,147 total raw documents)
djinni_dataset.corrections: Corrected earlier misattribution to Roman Koshkin (who published on speech translation at ACL 2024, not the Djinni dataset). Confirmed authors are Drushchak & Romanyshyn. Confirmed zero paired labels exist in source files.

djinni_cb.status: Diagnostic questionnaire framework built on candidate-job texts, evaluating keyword gatekeeping vs holistic matching.
djinni_cb.compatibility: Evaluates reasoning rubrics, not standard 3-class hiring fit.
